docs.description: One item in a vertical section nav rail — settings and admin sub-navigation. 5 variants: state (default, hover, focus, selected, disabled); selected maps to aria-current=page and uses tint + indicator, not colour alone. Props: label (text), icon (instance swap). Part of the Section Nav pattern; for primary app navigation use Nav Item inside Sidebar.
